title: Secure Backend Architecture
summary: Secure backends combine transport security (HTTPS), validation, parameterized SQL, authentication, authorization, and least-privilege infrastructure.
objectives: List layers of defense for a small API
Apply least privilege to DB credentials

content.md: Treat every request as untrusted. Validate, authenticate, authorize, then access data with bound parameters under a DB user that cannot DROP SCHEMA.
